# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

This unreleased servicing line backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixes a WinUI DLL loading regression.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported** — The 3.119.x line now supports building against the Apple 26.0 SDKs with unversioned application target framework monikers. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL resolved for .NET 9 consumers** — Fixed a missing WinUI Projection DLL that caused load failures for apps targeting .NET 9. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
